name: Zephagamon
main_effect:
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
＜Vortex＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[When Digivolving] You may unsuspend 1 Digimon. Then, you may suspend 1 Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon suspend, you may play 1 3000 DP or lower green Digimon card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits from your hand without paying the cost. For each suspended Digimon, add 2000 to this effect's DP maximum.
set_name: EX-11: Extra Booster Dawn of Liberator
